title: Rows and settings
description: Widgets for rows in task, project, note, trash and filter lists, plus the settings groups, setting rows and shortcut rows in the Taskscape settings screens. Built from the 38 rows in spec/inventory/rows-rows.json, grouped into 18 variants.

variants.name: task row, one line, depth 0
variants.description: Top-level task that fits on one line. Covers the open and done states of the same row. Main-window rows are recorded as kind task-row; the draft-inspector copies are recorded as kind list-row. Merged on look and click behaviour; the draft copies also have a check that toggles done, which the main-window rows do not document (uncertain).
variants.look: Title font 500 14px/16.625px at x 47; row 32 px tall (draft boxes 0,175, 0,207 and 0,144 at 860x32). Open colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) light / oklch(0.94 0.004 260) dark. Done colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) light / oklch(0.57 0.011 262) dark with strikethrough.
states: done (strikethrough, grey text, checked in draft)
variants.behaviour: Clicking the title selects the task. Main window: feeds the PreviewPanel (TaskInspector). Draft-inspector: check toggles done, row body selects. Handlers for the main window are not in the inventory files.

variants.name: task row, two lines with subtitle
variants.description: Open top-level task with a secondary note line under the title. Draft copy is recorded as kind list-row.
variants.look: 46 px tall (main-window tree box 0,98 860x46). Title font 500 14px/16.625px at x 47. Subtitle small secondary text, 12.5px in main window (about 12px estimated in draft).
variants.behaviour: Clicking the title selects the task (TaskInspector). Draft: check toggles done, row body selects. Handlers not in the inventory files.

variants.name: task row, parent with subtasks, expanded
variants.description: Top-level task that owns a subtask group and shows it expanded. Draft copy adds a subtask count badge.
variants.look: 126 px tall (draft box 0,238 860x126). Title font 500 14px/16.625px at x 47. Open colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) light / oklch(0.94 0.004 260) dark.
variants.behaviour: Clicking the title selects the task (TaskInspector). Draft: chevron toggles the subtasks. Handler not read.

variants.name: subtask row, indented 24 px
variants.description: Subtask shown under an expanded parent, indented one level. Open and completed subtasks share the variant. Main-window row is kind task-row; draft copies are kind list-row.
variants.look: Title font 500 14px/16.625px at x 71 (24 px indent). Open colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) light / oklch(0.94 0.004 260) dark; completed colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) light / oklch(0.57 0.011 262) dark with strikethrough. Draft rows 32 px tall.
variants.behaviour: Clicking the title selects the task (TaskInspector). Draft: check toggles done, row body selects.

variants.name: task row, split-view pane
variants.description: Tasks of the second list shown in the right pane of split view. Kept separate from the main list because the checkbox sits at x 451 in this placement (uncertain whether that is a real layout difference).
variants.look: Title font 500 14px/16.625px. Open colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262); completed colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264). Checkbox at x 451.
variants.behaviour: Clicking the title selects the task (TaskInspector). Handler not in the inventory files.
examples: Finish the novel on the nightstand
Read the long article on soil health

variants.name: task tree row, root (depth 0)
variants.description: Root task in the task-list tree. Rich row with multi-select, drag and drop, and a context menu.
variants.look: Title font 500 14px/16.625px, title boxes at x 47. Row min-h-9 (about 31-32 px); row with a note about 46 px. Right padding pr-space-6.
states: nest drop target (ring and selection background)
variants.behaviour: Click calls paneRowClick; Cmd/Ctrl toggles and Shift extends a range (TaskRow.tsx:328-333 forwards modifiers). Double-click toggles done. Right-click opens the row context menu. Drag moves the task or selection; drop zone by vertical position: top 30% before, bottom 30% after, middle nests.

variants.name: task tree row, subtask (depth 1)
variants.description: Subtask nested under its parent in the task-list tree. Same widget as the root row, indented.
variants.look: Left padding depth x 24px; title at x 71, font 500 14px/16.625px. Round select at x 44. Hairline dividers start at x about 70. Title boxes at [71,277,59,16], [71,308,106,16], [71,340,47,16].
states: hidden when the parent is collapsed (collapsed-all)
variants.behaviour: Same as root rows: click selects, Cmd/Ctrl toggles, Shift extends, double-click toggles done, right-click opens the row menu, drag nests or reorders.

variants.name: subtask row, inspector with checkbox
variants.description: Subtask shown in the task inspector's Subtasks section. Recurses into its own children.
variants.look: Row h-8, rounded-field, -mx-1.5, hover background wash-1. Paddingleft 6 at depth 0, 18 px per extra depth. Row box 305x28; rows spaced 28-30 px; title text at x 897. Font not recorded.
variants.behaviour: Checkbox toggles done. Title button selects that task.

variants.name: bulleted list item, note body
variants.component: Note body bulleted list (RichTextEditor, no separate component)
variants.description: Bullet item inside a note body. Not a standalone component; edited inside the note's RichTextEditor.
variants.look: Font 400 13.5px/17.5px, colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262). Bullets at about x 889 (from screenshot).
states: focused (partly covered by the toolbar while editing)
variants.behaviour: None on its own; the list belongs to the note body and is edited inside that RichTextEditor.

variants.name: task name row, component not identified
variants.description: Plain task-name row in the multi-select, filter and trash lists, where the component is not identified. Merged because look and inferred click behaviour match. Uncertain: may be one of the known TaskRow or TaskRow2 components.
variants.look: Font 500 14px/16.625px. Open colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262); done colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) with strikethrough. Filter rows about 31-38 px apart with hairline separators; subtask rows at x 71, top-level at x 47.
variants.behaviour: Click opens or selects the task and opens the task inspector (inferred, not confirmed in the code).

variants.name: trash row, deleted root task
variants.description: Deleted root item in the trash list, with restore and delete actions shown on hover.
variants.look: Code: h-9 (36px), px-space-5, gap-space-5, rounded-field. Measured rows 31 px apart (y 131 and 162). Row 1 title about y 138-152; row 2 title about y 169-183.
states: hover (wash-1 background; the two icon buttons become visible)
variants.behaviour: Hover reveals two icon buttons (restore and delete). Clicking the row body is not captured in either recording.

variants.name: project row, switcher menu
variants.description: One project in the project switcher menu. Shows a check when selected.
variants.look: h-9, px-space-6, gap-space-4, flex, items-center, cursor default. Measured row pitch about 32 px (y 53 and 85). Selected check: Icon check, Label tone accent, 15x15 at 122,56, colour oklch(0.6 0.2 255).
states: hover (wash-2 background, reveals edit and delete icons)
variants.behaviour: Click calls selectProject(p.id) and closes the menu (ProjectSwitcher.tsx:57-60). No tooltip on the row.

variants.name: settings group card
variants.description: Labelled container card that groups setting rows in the settings panes. Container only, not interactive.
variants.look: Appearance and Tasks: stacked bordered card with rounded corners (radius not recorded); Appearance box 172,58 991x162; Tasks box 172,238 991x77. Screenshots box 172,58 991x191 (border not recorded).
states: changed (only when a change is pending; onDiscard set; not in recorded states)
search result (label 'General · Appearance', only the matching row shown)
variants.behaviour: Container only. No action of its own.

variants.name: shortcut scope group, labelled
variants.description: Scope group that holds the shortcut rows for one scope (shortcutsPane.tsx:6-10). Only the Global group has a hint line.
variants.look: Global 991x97 at 172,93; Main window 991x1140 at 172,207; Capture bar 991x60 at 172,1365.
variants.behaviour: Scrolls with the pane content. No action of its own.

variants.name: setting row, stacked control
variants.description: Setting row with the control on its own full-width line under the title and description. Covers the Segmented, PathButton and button controls. Capture mode has no description but has a footnote.
variants.look: Stacked layout. Measured boxes: Capture mode 173,82 989x88; Saved to 173,169 989x79; Data folder 989x79; Restore defaults 989x86. Theme box not recorded.
variants.behaviour: Container only; the control inside does the action (Segmented for Theme and Capture mode, PathButton for Saved to and Data folder, a button for Restore defaults).
examples: Follow the system appearance, or pin one.

variants.name: setting row, inline with toggle
variants.description: Setting row with title and description on the left and a Toggle on the right. Reduced motion shows a footnote when a motion force is active.
variants.look: Inline layout (default). Show completed tasks box 173,261 989x53.
states: shown alone as the only search result (settings-search)
variants.behaviour: Container only; the control is the Toggle.
examples: Cuts animations and transitions to the minimum.
Keep finished tasks in the list instead of hiding them.

variants.name: setting row, inline, app info
variants.description: Inline setting row that shows the app name and a short description, with the version on the right. No toggle or action.
variants.look: Inline layout, 989x54. Version shown on the right.
examples: A macOS task manager with a menu-bar capture bar.

variants.name: shortcut row, keycap
variants.description: One keyboard shortcut: label on the left and a keycap on the right. Its footnote slot shows an error line when a rebind fails (shortcutsPane.tsx:18-23). 34 rows in the default state.
variants.look: Row x 173 to 1162, height 36 (35 on some last rows); keycap right edge at x 1153; text vertically centred.
variants.behaviour: Clicking the keycap records a new key combination for that row. The row itself is not clickable (code takes precedence over the screenshot reading).
